title: Purple Hammer Warrior
description: A female warrior with purple hair stands in a dynamic combat stance, gripping a massive purple warhammer with both hands. She wears a white and purple outfit with armored gauntlets, greaves, and boots, set against a plain dark gray background.
prompt: A confident young woman with short purple hair and determined expression stands in a powerful combat stance, holding a very large purple warhammer with intricate white lightning patterns across the head. She wears a cropped white and purple armored top, white pants with purple accents, matching gauntlets and greaves, and white boots. Dynamic pose with one arm extended, full body visible, clean dark gray background, stylized fantasy character art.
